name: Read Receipts
description: Sent, delivered and seen status on messages from chosen senders, with per-recipient detail.

settings_schema.header: Receipts are tracked only for messages sent by the senders listed below. Recipients see a small notice on those messages.
settings_schema.footer: Delivered: the recipient had Mattermost open (web, desktop or mobile app connected) after the message was sent. Seen: the recipient opened the conversation with the window in focus after the message was sent. Neither proves the text was read.

settings.help_text: Comma-separated usernames whose messages get receipts, for example: alice, hr.team
Comma-separated role names whose members get receipts. Use system_user for everyone. Leave empty to use only the usernames above.
Messages in conversations with more recipients than this are not tracked.
Receipts are kept this long, then deleted.
Show recipients a small "read receipt" mark on tracked messages. Keep on: people should know when their reading is reported.
